title: BenchFEA input file, format 1.0
description: Everything needed to analyse and design a 3D frame structure. Collections are objects keyed by id, so JSON pointers such as /members/B1/section stay valid when items are added or removed. All dimensional numbers are in the consistent units built from units.force and units.length.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editors.

formatVersion.description: Version of the file format (semantic versioning, see docs/FORMAT_VERSIONING.md).

units.description: Units of every dimensional number in the file.

conventions.description: Sign and axis conventions of this file. Only the listed values are supported; anything else is refused. Explained in docs/CONVENTIONS.md.

verticalAxis.description: Global axis that points up. Sets the default member orientation, the default gravity direction (negative vertical) and the default diaphragm normal.

handedness.description: Global and local axes are right-handed.

rotations.description: Rotations and moments are positive by the right-hand rule about the positive axis.

memberLocalX.description: Member local x runs from node i to node j.

defaultOrientation.description: Default rule for local y and z (see member.orientation).

memberEndForces.description: Member end forces are the forces and moments the joints exert on the member ends, in member local axes.

internalForces.description: Internal forces are the stress resultants acting on the cross-section face whose outward normal is +local x, as components along the local axes (axial tension positive).

reactions.description: Reactions are the forces and moments the supports exert on the structure, in global axes.

loads.description: Load values are positive along (forces) or about (moments) the positive axis of their direction.

supports.description: Supports, keyed by the id of the supported node.

constraints.description: Rigid links and rigid diaphragms, keyed by id.

combinations.description: Load combinations, keyed by id. Results are produced per combination.

analysis.description: Analysis options. Everything here AFFECTS ANALYSIS.

type.description: Default analysis type of combinations: firstOrder = linear elastic; secondOrder = geometrically nonlinear (geometric stiffness updated iteratively, P-Delta and P-delta).

shearDeformation.description: Include shear deformation (Timoshenko beam) using the section shear areas.

resultStations.description: Number of equally spaced result stations per member, ends included.

convergenceTolerance.description: Iterative analyses stop when the norm of the displacement change is below this fraction of the displacement norm.

alpha.description: Second-order analyses are run at alpha times the combination loads and the results divided by alpha (AISC 360-22 C2.1(d): 1.0 for LRFD, 1.6 for ASD).

equilibriumTolerance.description: Largest relative out-of-balance force accepted in the invariants report.

pivotTolerance.description: Relative pivot size below which the stiffness matrix is declared singular (mechanism).

geometryTolerance.description: Lengths smaller than this fraction of the model size count as zero.

buckling.description: Linear (eigenvalue) buckling analysis. Absent: not performed.

combinations.description: Reference combinations: buckling factors multiply these loadings.

modes.description: Number of buckling modes per reference combination.

stiffnessReduction.description: Stiffness reduction for stability design (AISC 360-22 C2.3). Used only in combinations with stiffnessReduction = true.

factor.description: Factor applied to all member stiffnesses (EA, EI, GJ, GAs).

tauB.description: Additional factor tau_b on flexural stiffness: "computed" (Eq. C2-2a/b from the member axial force, Pns = Fy*A), "none" (1.0), or a number.

members.description: Members whose stiffness is reduced. Default: all members.

design.description: Design input. Design-only data: nothing in this block can change analysis results.

autoMembers.description: true: every analysis member that is not part of an explicit design member is a design member by itself, with the same id.

defaults.description: Design variables applied to every design member unless overridden by a group or the member.

groups.description: Design groups: variables shared by several design members.

members.description: Design member ids in this group.

priority.description: When a design member is in several groups that set the same variable, the group with the highest priority wins; equal priority with different values is an error.

members.description: Design members. A design member is one analysis member or a chain of collinear analysis members (a physical member split at nodes).

additionalProperties.description: A design member with its own variables.

members.description: Analysis member ids forming this design member, in order from its start to its end. Default: the single analysis member whose id equals this design member's id.

support.description: Support at a node (the key is the node id). Give `type` (shorthand), `dofs` (per-DOF), or both; entries in `dofs` override the shorthand. DOFs not mentioned are free. Imposed support displacements are loads (`supportDisplacement`) acting on fixed DOFs.

type.description: Shorthand: fixed = all six DOFs fixed; pinned = ux, uy, uz fixed; roller = only the translation along the vertical axis fixed.

ux.description: Restraint of this translational DOF: "fixed", "free", or {"spring": k} (linear elastic spring to ground).

uy.description: Restraint of this translational DOF: "fixed", "free", or {"spring": k} (linear elastic spring to ground).

uz.description: Restraint of this translational DOF: "fixed", "free", or {"spring": k} (linear elastic spring to ground).

rx.description: Restraint of this rotational DOF: "fixed", "free", or {"spring": k} (linear elastic spring to ground).

ry.description: Restraint of this rotational DOF: "fixed", "free", or {"spring": k} (linear elastic spring to ground).

rz.description: Restraint of this rotational DOF: "fixed", "free", or {"spring": k} (linear elastic spring to ground).

material.description: Linear elastic isotropic material. Give G or nu (or both; G is used for stiffness). The design checks use the same E, G, Fy, Fu unless a design variable of the same name overrides them.

description.description: Free text, e.g. the steel grade designation.

nu.description: Poisson's ratio, used only to derive G when G is absent.

unitWeight.description: Weight per unit volume, used by selfWeight loads.

Fy.description: Specified minimum yield stress. Required for design checks and for computed tau_b.

Fu.description: Specified minimum tensile strength. Required for design checks.

material.x-hint: A material needs `G` or `nu` in addition to `E`.

section.description: Prismatic cross-section. `type` selects how it is defined: by standard shape name (user-supplied AISC Shapes Database), by properties, or by parametric dimensions from which the engine computes the properties. Section axes: y = depth direction (web of an I-shape), z = width direction (parallel to the flanges); AISC x-x (major) axis = local z, AISC y-y (minor) axis = local y.

shape.description: Shape designation exactly as in the AISC Shapes Database v16.0 (e.g. "W14X90"). Needs the user-supplied database file.

overrides.description: Explicit values that replace the computed/looked-up section properties (e.g. a tabulated J or a shear area from a refined theory).

Iy.description: Second moment of area about local y.

Iz.description: Second moment of area about local z.

Asy.description: Shear area for shear force along local y.

Asz.description: Shear area for shear force along local z.

Iy.description: Second moment of area about local y (AISC minor axis for an I-shape).

Iz.description: Second moment of area about local z (AISC major axis for an I-shape).

Asy.description: Shear area for shear along local y. Absent: no shear deformation in that direction.

Asz.description: Shear area for shear along local z. Absent: no shear deformation in that direction.

Cw.description: Warping constant (design only; warping torsion is not analysed).

Sy.description: Elastic section modulus about local y (design only).

Sz.description: Elastic section modulus about local z (design only).

Zy.description: Plastic section modulus about local y (design only).

Zz.description: Plastic section modulus about local z (design only).

bf.description: Flange width (along local z); both flanges equal.

overrides.description: Explicit values that replace the computed/looked-up section properties (e.g. a tabulated J or a shear area from a refined theory).

Iy.description: Second moment of area about local y.

Iz.description: Second moment of area about local z.

Asy.description: Shear area for shear force along local y.

Asz.description: Shear area for shear force along local z.

overrides.description: Explicit values that replace the computed/looked-up section properties (e.g. a tabulated J or a shear area from a refined theory).

Iy.description: Second moment of area about local y.

Iz.description: Second moment of area about local z.

Asy.description: Shear area for shear force along local y.

Asz.description: Shear area for shear force along local z.

overrides.description: Explicit values that replace the computed/looked-up section properties (e.g. a tabulated J or a shear area from a refined theory).

Iy.description: Second moment of area about local y.

Iz.description: Second moment of area about local z.

Asy.description: Shear area for shear force along local y.

Asz.description: Shear area for shear force along local z.

overrides.description: Explicit values that replace the computed/looked-up section properties (e.g. a tabulated J or a shear area from a refined theory).

Iy.description: Second moment of area about local y.

Iz.description: Second moment of area about local z.

Asy.description: Shear area for shear force along local y.

Asz.description: Shear area for shear force along local z.

endRelease.description: Releases at one member end. DOFs not mentioned are rigidly connected.

ux.description: Release of this translational DOF between the member end and the node (member local axes): false = rigidly connected, true = fully released, {"spring": k} = partial release through a linear spring.

uy.description: Release of this translational DOF between the member end and the node (member local axes): false = rigidly connected, true = fully released, {"spring": k} = partial release through a linear spring.

uz.description: Release of this translational DOF between the member end and the node (member local axes): false = rigidly connected, true = fully released, {"spring": k} = partial release through a linear spring.

rx.description: Release of this rotational DOF between the member end and the node (member local axes): false = rigidly connected, true = fully released, {"spring": k} = partial release through a linear spring.

ry.description: Release of this rotational DOF between the member end and the node (member local axes): false = rigidly connected, true = fully released, {"spring": k} = partial release through a linear spring.

rz.description: Release of this rotational DOF between the member end and the node (member local axes): false = rigidly connected, true = fully released, {"spring": k} = partial release through a linear spring.

member.description: Straight prismatic member between two nodes.

type.description: frame = axial, shear, bending, torsion; truss = axial force only (pin-ended); tensionOnly / compressionOnly = truss that is removed when it would carry the other sign (iterative analysis).

i.description: Start node id (local x runs from i to j).

orientation.description: Orientation of the local y and z axes about local x. Default rule: local y lies in the plane of local x and the global vertical axis and points to the +vertical side; for a vertical member local y = global +X. See docs/CONVENTIONS.md.

referenceVector.description: Global vector replacing the vertical axis in the default rule: local y lies in the plane of local x and this vector, on the vector's side. Must not be parallel to the member.

roll.description: Rotation of local y and z about +local x (right-hand rule), applied after the default rule or the reference vector.

releases.description: End releases in member local axes.

offsets.description: Rigid end offsets: vectors from each node to the corresponding end of the flexible length.

axes.description: Axes of the offset vectors: global, or local = the triad of the node-to-node line (same orientation rule).

i.description: Offset from node i to the flexible start.

j.description: Offset from node j to the flexible end.

constraint.description: Exact kinematic constraint (small-displacement rigid-body relation between a master node and slave nodes).

type.description: rigidLink = all six DOFs of every slave follow the master as a rigid body; rigidDiaphragm = the two in-plane translations and the rotation about the normal follow the master, other DOFs stay independent.

normal.description: Global axis normal to the diaphragm plane. Default: the vertical axis.

direction.description: Load direction: X, Y, Z = global axes; x, y, z = member local axes. Positive values act along the positive axis.

kind.description: force = concentrated force along `direction`; moment = concentrated moment about `direction`.

value.description: Magnitude: a force, or a moment (force*length) when kind = moment.

position.description: Location of the load along the member.

positionType.description: How positions along the member are given: relative = fraction of the flexible length (0 at end i, 1 at end j); absolute = distance from the flexible start.

direction.description: Load direction: X, Y, Z = global axes; x, y, z = member local axes. Positive values act along the positive axis.

w1.description: Intensity at `start` (force per unit length of member, or per unit projected length when projected = true).

w2.description: Intensity at `end`; linear variation between. Default: w1 (uniform).

end.description: End of the loaded length. Default: the member end.

positionType.description: How positions along the member are given: relative = fraction of the flexible length (0 at end i, 1 at end j); absolute = distance from the flexible start.

projected.description: Global directions only: intensities are per unit length of the member's projection on the plane normal to the load direction (e.g. snow on a sloping rafter).

factor.description: Multiplier on the weight (unitWeight * A per unit length of flexible member).

direction.description: Global direction of gravity (normalised by the engine). Default: the negative vertical axis.

members.description: Members that receive self weight. Default: all members.

node.description: Supported node id; every DOF given here must be "fixed" at that support.

loadCase.description: A named set of loads that act together.

combination.description: Factored sum of load cases, analysed as one loading.

factors.description: Load factor per load case id.

analysisType.description: Analysis type for this combination. Default: analysis.type.

purpose.description: strength = used for strength design checks; serviceability = used for deflection checks.

stiffnessReduction.description: Apply analysis.stiffnessReduction (AISC 360-22 C2.3) in this combination. AFFECTS ANALYSIS.

notionalLoad.description: Notional lateral loads added in this combination (AISC 360-22 C2.2b): at every node, coefficient * (factored gravity load applied at that node, including member loads lumped statically to the member ends), acting along `direction`. AFFECTS ANALYSIS. Absent: none.

direction.description: Global horizontal direction of the notional loads (normalised by the engine; must be perpendicular to the vertical axis).

designVariables.description: Design variables (DESIGN ONLY: none of these can influence the analysis). Axis names follow AISC: x = major axis (= member local z), y = minor axis (= member local y), z = longitudinal axis (torsion). Each variable is resolved in the order: design member > group(s) > design.defaults > built-in default.

role.description: Member role. Default: truss-type members = brace; frame members parallel to the vertical axis = column; other frame members = beam.

E.description: Modulus of elasticity used by the design checks. Default: E of the member's material. An override is DESIGN ONLY: the analysis always uses the material's E.

G.description: Shear modulus used by the design checks. Default: G of the member's material. An override is DESIGN ONLY: the analysis always uses the material's G.

Fy.description: Specified minimum yield stress used by the design checks. Default: Fy of the member's material. DESIGN ONLY: a computed tau_b (analysis.stiffnessReduction) always uses the material's Fy.

Fu.description: Specified minimum tensile strength used by the design checks. Default: Fu of the member's material.

Lx.description: Unbraced length for flexural buckling about the major (x) axis. Default: from bracing.major, else the design member length.

Ly.description: Unbraced length for flexural buckling about the minor (y) axis. Default: from bracing.minor, else the design member length.

Lz.description: Unbraced length for torsional buckling. Default: from bracing.torsion, else the design member length.

Lb.description: Unbraced length for lateral-torsional buckling. Default: from bracing.topFlange / bracing.bottomFlange, else the design member length.

Kx.description: Effective length factor, major axis flexural buckling.

Ky.description: Effective length factor, minor axis flexural buckling.

bracing.description: Intermediate bracing points along the design member. Within one level (member, group or defaults) an unbraced length and the matching bracing list must not both be given.

positionType.description: relative = fractions of the design member length; absolute = distances from its start.

major.description: Locations of intermediate points braced against major-axis (x) flexural buckling, measured from the start of the design member (its ends are always braced points).

minor.description: Locations of intermediate points braced against minor-axis (y) flexural buckling, measured from the start of the design member (its ends are always braced points).

torsion.description: Locations of intermediate points braced against twist (torsional buckling), measured from the start of the design member (its ends are always braced points).

topFlange.description: Locations of intermediate points braced against lateral movement of the top flange (the flange on the +local y side), for lateral-torsional buckling, measured from the start of the design member (its ends are always braced points).

bottomFlange.description: Locations of intermediate points braced against lateral movement of the bottom flange (the flange on the -local y side), for lateral-torsional buckling, measured from the start of the design member (its ends are always braced points).

Cb.description: Lateral-torsional buckling modification factor: a number, or "computed" from the moment diagram of each unbraced segment (AISC 360-22 Eq. F1-1).
Cb.x-hint: Give a positive number or the string "computed".

Cmx.description: Equivalent uniform moment factor Cm for major-axis bending (AISC 360-22 App. 8.1.2), a number or "computed".
Cmx.x-hint: Give a positive number or the string "computed".

Cmy.description: Equivalent uniform moment factor Cm for minor-axis bending (AISC 360-22 App. 8.1.2), a number or "computed".
Cmy.x-hint: Give a positive number or the string "computed".

sideswayInhibited.description: Sidesway flag: true when relative lateral translation of the member ends is prevented (braced frame).

An.description: Net area for tension rupture. Default: the gross area (no holes).

U.description: Shear lag factor for tension rupture.

maxSlendernessCompression.description: Limit on Lc/r for members in compression (advisory check).

maxSlendernessTension.description: Limit on L/r for members in tension (advisory check).

deflectionLimits.description: Deflection limits to check. Default: none.

items.description: One deflection limit; give spanRatio and/or absolute.

spanRatio.description: n in the limit L/n, L = design member length.

direction.description: Deflection component checked, in member local axes, measured relative to the chord through the design member ends.

combinations.description: Combination ids the limit applies to. Default: every combination with purpose = serviceability.
